strategyPoints: Tire wear will be a huge factor on this 14.12km circuit, with drivers needing to manage their rubber throughout the stint.
With such a long lap, the pit window is extended, giving teams more flexibility with their strategy.
Fuel consumption is critical here, requiring careful management from both the driver and the team.
The length of this circuit means that any safety car period can significantly impact the race strategy.
Teams will need to weigh up the advantages of a shorter stop versus the time lost on track.
Getting the tire pressures right is crucial, especially with the high-speed nature of this track.
With the unpredictable Ardennes weather, teams need to be ready to adapt their strategy at any moment.
A well-timed pit stop can make all the difference on this long and challenging circuit.
